propositions: The test invokes Pandoc for all 232 eligible prose units despite requiring only existential witnesses (at least one eligible unit and at least one changed unit).
Runtime measurement shows 232 subprocess calls / 8.865s under exhaustive evaluation versus 1 call / 0.036s when stopping after both witnesses exist.

An exact short-circuit implementation must preserve existential postconditions: fail if zero eligible units, fail if all eligible units render identically, and stop rendering after both witnesses are observed.
Full-corpus property tests (idempotence, no-decay, richness, hardening) that independently consume corpus_pass1 must retain unchanged coverage.
A defect-seeded mutation removing both short-circuit exits must return the test to RED with call count 232 instead of 1.
The fix is test-only (no product path changes) and eliminates 231 unnecessary Pandoc subprocesses and ~8.8s CI wall time.
